generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: A change in fuel type or sulfur content may require a permit to modify and operate.
generatorSets.control_technologies: Caterpillar CAT Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) — closed-loop SCR with urea injection and catalyst bed temperature probes (urea enabled at 572°F and ≥30% load; urea injection discontinued above 930°F); use of ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel (≤15 ppm sulfur) to control SO2
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency power generation due to failure or loss of primary electrical service beyond the facility’s reasonable control (allowed while service is unavailable); ISO-declared emergency participation in an ISO Emergency Load Response Program (limited to 60 hours per generator per calendar year, with notification to DEQ after contracting); Critical Power Generation for loss or anticipated loss of acceptable power beyond the facility’s reasonable control (allowed until acceptable service is restored or the loss is no longer reasonably anticipated); Alternate Power Generation for voluntary peak-shaving, demand response, or interruptible power arrangements—only for units with SCR and only when operating at a load sufficient to sustain urea injection (for DCD-D: catalyst bed ≥572°F and ≥30% load); periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
generatorSets.operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow: Consecutive 12-month rolling period, calculated monthly; compliance demonstrated by adding the most recently completed calendar month to the totals for the preceding eleven months.

generatorSets.control_technologies: Caterpillar CAT Selective Catalytic Reduction (closed-loop SCR with urea injection and catalyst-bed temperature monitoring); use of ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel (<= 15 ppm sulfur) to control SO2; proper operating practices per manufacturer to control CO, VOC, and visible emissions

generatorSets.observationFrequency: once per day during each test firing and during days in which the engine generator sets are called into service
